name: Happy Forgings Ltd
about: Incorporated in July 1979, Happy Forgings Limited is an Indian manufacturer specializing in designing and manufacturing heavy forgings and high-precision machined components.[1]
keyPoints:
Leading Forging Company[1]
HFL is the 4th largest manufacturer of complex and safety-critical, heavy-forged, and precision-machined components in India by forging capacity

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 27.4% CAGR over last 5 years
